caption:
Day 2 / 50 fundraising to get Isaiah Stem cell therapy to help him walk again 💪 

#motivation #kindness #charity #spinalcordinjury #wheelchair #dad #rehab #physicaltherapy #stemcelltherapy #resilience

5 years ago today I was shot 3 times and told I’d be lucky to walk normally again. 

Today on June 29th 2025 , 5:45pm at the exact minute I was shot 5 years ago, I finished a full day of triathlon training. 1 hour of swimming , 3 hours of biking and 3 hours of running. 

That adds up to about 2.5k in the water , 90k on the bike and 30k on the run. (It should have been about 120k on the bike but I got a flat lol.) 

Not only am I grateful to be alive, but I’m grateful to have the chance to keep chasing big goals, and for the people around me who make this possible. 

To my family , friends , community, support team and everyone who believed in me, I love y’all.

And to those who doubted me (a few doctors names I’ll keep private) … thank you too. I wouldn’t be here without you. 

Also - a major thank you to my coach Myrianne Côte, who I can confidently say I’d have very little chance of tackling this upcoming Iron Man without. 

5 weeks until Iron Man Ottawa 🎉

caption:
Gavin is an absolute warrior 💪 

#traumarecovery #resilience #gunviolence #truecrime #htgrcharity #kindness #spinalcordinjury #physiotherapy

When Zoe was diagnosed with Diamond Blackfan anemia shortly after birth, her family knew her childhood would be a little bit different. 

Every 10th day for her entire life Zoe has had to go to the hospital. 

The reason she spends so much time in hospital is because her body can’t create enough red blood cells to survive on its own. 

She depends on lifesaving red blood cell transfusions to stay healthy. 

Without these transfusions, her condition becomes terminal. 

There is only one cure to her illness. A stem cell transplant. 

By receiving a stem cell transplant Zoe would be able to change the make up of her bone marrow and produce her own red blood cells. 

The problem is, there is no registered stem cell donors in the world who are a match for Zoe. 

To join the registry, all you need to do is order a cotton swab from the link in my bio, swab your cheeks, and mail the DNA back. 

99% of the time you won’t be a match for somebody , but 1% of the time you will have the chance to save someone like Zoe’s life ❤️‍🩹

If you are selected as a donor, the process is easy. It’s basically a long blood donation. 

Most donors I’ve spoken to have told me they feel 100% healthy that same night. 

So go check out the link in my bio if you want to help change Zoe’s life ❤️‍🩹

I’ve never been more inspired by someone than @peacock_brandon and what he’s had to overcome. Not only that, I get to call him one of the closest people in my life. Someone I’ve known for 17 years now

Brandon didn’t JUST survive this, he came out with a new mentality towards life that is continuously changing the lives of trauma survivors with his charity @htgrcanada 

From taking a bullet for someone, to surviving 3 gunshot wounds, to recovering in 4 months, to running a marathon 1 year later, and now paying for the rehabilitation of several other grantees… it’s a story I love sharing more than anything else

Im proud of this human. For what he represents in my life and so many others

The hero’s journey is one that can begin in a moment, but takes years to see through, and seeing Brandon through the last 3 years has been a beautiful journey to witness

caption:
My brother Jamey had two minutes with my favourite author Jesse Itzler yesterday and elevator pitched my story to him. He sent me this message in a video response. 

Why was this so important to me? Jesse is probably the only “celebrity” who’s DMs I’ve ever dove into. This man’s book “Living With a Seal” is quite literally the book that saved my quality of life. When I was in hospital, in what could have been a really dark time, I kept referring back to the book for inspiration. Not to mention the fact I have watched virtually all of his podcasts as well. His lessons on positivity through struggle and learning to fall in love with hardships have been instrumental in allowing me to accomplish the things I have in recent memory. 

I’m ecstatic to be able to share this with you all and if that opportunity to connect does come to fruition I’ll make sure to keep my amazing network of support in the loop.
